content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sample storage systems and genomic sequencing for life science labs; no contract sterilization or radiation processing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Research reagents, instruments and clinical diagnostic kits; sells products rather than sterilizing or testing customers' products."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced device components and contract manufacturing for device OEMs; does not sterilize or test customers' products for a fee."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Clinical lab testing for patients and providers, billed to payers; does not sterilize or perform product sterility testing for manufacturers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Makes and sells radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and generators to hospitals; no sterilization services or contract processing for manufacturers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Radiation detection instruments and dosimetry for nuclear and medical users; does not sterilize or test customers' healthcare products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Research instruments, test kits and reagents sold to labs; testing services are a minor line, not product sterility or sterilization."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Medical tapes, dressings and health information software sold to providers; no contract sterilization or product testing for manufacturers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud software for life sciences companies; no physical sterilization, lab testing or radiation processing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding printers, water instruments and treatment equipment sold as products; no contract sterilization or lab testing services."}]}
